title: studio → pipelines: continue a paused batch
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.resume` (stream CMD) in the transaction that changes the batch; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`, n = the batch's command counter (submit = 1, +1 per later command). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines`, filter `cmd.pipeline.>`, one message at a time, in order). Sent on POST /v1/studio/batches/{id}/resume, which is also how a batch paused by a restart of pipelines_service continues: threads continue, a step without a stored result asks studio.runs.create again under its key (same run back), a result already known resumes its thread.
